functions.description: Parse the amount of gas given as raw text (number, scale word, unit) and convert it to moles.
inputs: the amount of gas with unit as raw text

functions.description: Parse the gas volume given as raw text and convert it to cubic metres, handling m3, dm3, L, mL and cm3.
inputs: the gas volume with unit as raw text

functions.description: Parse the gas temperature given as raw text and convert it to kelvin, handling K, °C and °F.
inputs: the gas temperature with unit as raw text

functions.description: Compute pressure in pascals as nRT/V from moles, temperature in kelvin, volume in cubic metres and the gas constant R using Decimal arithmetic.
inputs: gas constant R in J/(mol K)

functions.description: Convert a pressure in pascals to atmospheres by dividing by 101325 Pa per atm.
Compute the pressure of an ideal gas in pascals and atmospheres from the amount of gas, its volume and its temperature using pV = nRT.
inputs: the amount of gas with unit
the chemical formula or name of the gas
the volume of the gas with unit
the temperature of the gas with unit

entry_points.text: Using pV = nRT, find the pressure of ●1 of ●2 occupying ●3 at ●4.

params.description: the amount of gas with unit
params.validity_range: Positive amount of substance, typically expressed in mol (or mmol/kmol); must be greater than zero.

params.description: the chemical formula or name of the gas
params.validity_range: Any gas that can reasonably be treated as ideal; the identity does not affect the calculation.

params.description: the volume of the gas with unit
params.validity_range: Positive volume in m3, dm3, L, mL or cm3; must be greater than zero.

params.description: the temperature of the gas with unit
params.validity_range: Temperature above absolute zero (K > 0, °C > -273.15, °F > -459.67) in K, °C or °F.
